name: Arda Akgül
bio: Arda Akgül studies Economics and Business Administration at TED University in Ankara. He is an Undergraduate Research Assistant at TEDUsTRC and a Researcher at DASAM. His work focuses on trade, sustainability, energy policy, and technology in public life. Alongside research and writing, he contributes to student media at RadioTEDU and develops data-driven projects.

education.detail: GPA: 3.83. Thesis: EU exposure, CBAM, and sustainability reporting in the aluminum sector.
